_comment: Notbigville KS demo town for public basegame. Atlas pocket at (35,10) on earth_america.json. Hub NB00001 Main Street.

rooms.title: Notbigville - Main Street - Plaza
rooms.description: A modest Kansas square where two highways meet under a wide prairie sky. A storm-shelter sign rattles on the community board; grain elevators glint west of town.

rooms.title: Notbigville - Storm Watch Office - Desk
rooms.description: Radar screens wash the room in green light. A chase board lists active storm cells; folding chairs face a wall of regional climate charts.

rooms.title: Notbigville - Community Shelter - Cellar
rooms.description: Concrete steps lead down to a reinforced cellar stocked with cots, water, and a hand-crank radio. The door is heavy enough to trust when the sirens sound.

rooms.title: Notbigville - General Store - Counter
rooms.description: Shelves of dry goods and storm supplies. The proprietor keeps a tornado siren cheat-sheet taped beside the register.

shop_stock.description: A sturdy kerosene lantern with a storm-glass chimney.
Vacuum-sealed biscuits and jerky for long drives.

rooms.title: Notbigville - Clinic - Ward
rooms.description: A plain ward with cots and antiseptic smell. Storm-injury triage notes are pinned beside the supply cabinet.

rooms.title: Notbigville - Post Office - Counter
rooms.description: Cubbyholes, a clerk's stamp, and a coin payphone bolted to the wall. Letters still leave town when the sky is clear.

rooms.title: Notbigville - News Office - Desk
rooms.description: A cramped weekly paper office: coffee-stained storyboard, a wire basket of undeveloped shots, and a editor's desk buried under town gossip.

rooms.title: Notbigville - Saloon - Bar
rooms.description: A narrow saloon with a scuffed bar and a plank wall that looks like it has taken a beating before.

rooms.title: Notbigville - Back Alley - Gravel
rooms.description: Trash bins and gravel behind the saloon. The plank wall still rattles from the last brawl.

rooms.title: Notbigville - Highway Shoulder - Mile Marker
rooms.description: Packed shoulder where US-281 meets the county road. Open prairie rolls away in every direction; the town square lies north.

rooms.title: Notbigville - Grain Elevator - Shed
rooms.description: A lean-to beside the grain elevator where prairie critters nest in the chaff. The door hangs open on one hinge. Scuffed dirt and a chalk circle mark a local sparring spot.

rooms.title: Notbigville - Sheriff - Holding Cell
rooms.description: A bare concrete cell with a bench bolted to the wall. The sheriff's desk is just outside the bars.

rooms.title: Notbigville - Observatory Knoll - Lookout
rooms.description: A grassy rise with a shuttered observatory dome. The horizon is nothing but sky -- useful for watching weather roll in.

rooms.title: Notbigville - Prairie Inn - Lobby
rooms.description: A tidy lobby with a check-in desk and a creaky staircase. A chalkboard lists nightly rates.
